lines: Bhar de shola-e-mai, saqi, is darja har ek paimane mein
couplets.en: Pour the fire of wine, cupbearer, into every goblet.

lines: Mai-khwar bhi tauba kar baithe, jab kuchh na raha maikhane mein
couplets.en: Even the drinkers repented when the tavern had nothing left.

lines: Halke se nazuk nashe se kat jaati hain gham ki zanjeeren
couplets.en: The lightest intoxication can undo the chains of grief.

lines: Keh do ke mohabbat raqs kare duniya ke sayyad-khane mein
couplets.en: Tell love to dance within the world's cage.

lines: Zinda hai ishq ki garmi se insaan ki rooh-e-azadi
couplets.en: Love's warmth keeps the human spirit free.

lines: Sholon pe na paani phir jaaye, aag hi ghatane mein
couplets.en: Take care the flames do not go out as you try to tame them.

lines: Tabinda rahe imaan, Shakeel, isko hi ibadat kehte hain
couplets.en: Let faith keep shining, Shakeel, for that is worship.

lines: Sajde ke liye kuchh qaid nahin, Kaabe mein ho ya butkhane mein
couplets.en: You may bow anywhere, in the Kaaba or in a temple of idols.
